## What changed and why

Describe the user-facing change and motivation. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Type and scope

Bug fix, feature, docs, maintenance, or breaking change? State what is deliberately out of scope.

## Verification

List the exact checks and synthetic examples run, with results. Explain any checks not run.

## Risks and compatibility

Describe changed CLI arguments, data formats, dependencies, external effects and rollback considerations.

## Checklist

- [ ] Local checks pass and regression tests cover behavior changes.
- [ ] Docs and examples match the implementation.
- [ ] No personal data, real transcripts, brand assets, credentials, account IDs or private links are included.
- [ ] All contributed code and assets may be distributed under the stated licenses.
- [ ] No live uploads or publishing happened during verification.
